description: Domino Effect (Rare perk) in House of Pips: Each consecutive scoring play adds 5 more points than the previous scoring play.
html:
Perks › Rare

Domino Effect

Rare perk · Scoring bonus

Each consecutive scoring play adds 5 more points than the previous scoring play.

In-game card text

How it works

Each scoring play gains +5 points for every scoring play you made in a row just before it, for each copy.

  • Your first scoring play of a streak gains nothing, the second gains +5, the third +10, and so on.
  • The streak breaks when you make a play that doesn't score, when you draw from the boneyard, and at the start of every hand. Rival's plays don't break it.

Worked example

Three scoring plays in a row with one Domino Effect: +0, then +5, then +10. With two copies: +0, +10, +20.

At a glance

RarityRare
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 600 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Uncommon perks.
